question: What claim is made about the transmission of the practice of the soul to the one addressed as Bhairavī?
premises: This practice of the soul is the object.
It has been told to you.
inference: The practice of the soul has been transmitted to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The content of that practice is not detailed in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
